acceptedWorkstreams.description: A demo playbook usually ends at the walkthrough; schools often reply later, not now. The form and walkthrough script stay as the accepted plan covers them. Tasks: outcome-and-follow-up playbook (content), timing rules (research).

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Short form, a named owner, and a 24-hour response playbook
acceptedWorkstreams.description: Draft a demo request form of no more than six fields (name, school or bootcamp, role, number of learners, what they want to see, preferred time), a routing rule (who owns each request and the backup), and a playbook: confirmation email wording, a reply within one working day, a 30-minute demo outline matched to schools, bootcamps or universities, and a follow-up email with next steps. Nothing goes live without approval. Tasks: form and routing (content), response emails and demo outline (content).
